								string text10 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.VAP_FLOW3." + text, "uom"));
								((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.V_MOLE_FLOW.#" + l, "id", (object)text);
								((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.V_MOLE_FLOW.#" + l, "value", text10, (object)((text4 == "YES") ? num18.Value : SigFigs(num18.Value, 4)));
							}
						}
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.ResumeNotifications();
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
		}

		private void cmdClose_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
		}

		private static double SigFigs(double value, int places)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (value == 0.0 || value == 1E+35)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			num = (int)(Math.Log(Math.Abs(value)) / Math.Log(10.0));
			return Round(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -num), -(places - 1)) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
		}

		private static double Round(double value, int places)
		{
			return Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToInt64(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -places))) / Math.Pow(10.0, -places);
		}

			{

	public class MMPetrofrac_Profil_TrayRe_LabelConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = value.ToString().Split(' ');
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length && i < 3; i++)
			{
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(array[i]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		private static double SigFigs(double value, int places)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (value == 0.0 || value == 1E+35)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			num = (int)(Math.Log(Math.Abs(value)) / Math.Log(10.0));
			return Round(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -num), -(places - 1)) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
		}

		private static double Round(double value, int places)
		{
			return Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToInt64(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -places))) / Math.Pow(10.0, -places);
		}

		private void OnUOMChanged()
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_TYPE.@id", "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string empty2 = string.Empty;
			int num = 0;
			switch (text)
			{
			case "MOLE-FLOW":
				num = 11;
				break;
			case "MASS-FLOW":
				num = 10;
				break;
			case "STDVOL-FLOW":
				num = 12;
				break;
			case "TEMP":
			case "VACT":
			case "TBPT":
			case "D86T":
			case "D86WT":
			case "TBPWT":
			case "VACWT":
			case "D1160T":
			case "D1160WT":
			case "PRPT-API":
			case "FLPT-API":
				num = 22;
				break;
			case "DUTY":
				num = 13;
				break;
			case "TBP-GAP":
			case "D86-GAP":
			case "TBPW-GAP":
			case "D86W-GAP":
				num = 31;
				break;
			case "RHOLSTD":
				num = 38;
				break;
			case "REIDVP":
			case "RVP-ASTM":
				num = 20;
				break;
			case "PROP-DIFF":
			case "PROP":
			{
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.PROPERTY.@id", "value"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					string text3 = MmgExtensions.MMGGetPropSetUnit((MMViewModel)(object)this, text2);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)text3);
					_currentUOM = text3;
				}
				else
				{
					ResetUOM();
				}
				return;
			}
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			num--;
			empty2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.Unit Set", "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty2))
			{
				empty2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("Top.appModelV8.Setup.Unit Set.Global.Input.INSET", "value"));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty2))
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			empty = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("Top.appModelV8.Setup.Units-Sets." + empty2 + ".Unit-Types.#" + num, "value"));
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)empty);
			_currentUOM = empty;
		}

		private void ResetUOM()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_currentUOM))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)"");
				_currentUOM = "";
			}
		}
